description: This Java class 'MethodContext' manages the state and environment for the Mini-language script engine within the Apache OFBiz framework, handling service and event contexts, environment variables, request/response objects, and security details.

classes.name: MethodContext
classes.description: A container for the Mini-language script engine state, managing environment variables, request/response, security, and context for service and event processing.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator object associated with this context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher object associated with this context.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment map using a FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment map by key, supporting expansion and syntax.

methods.name: getEnvMap
methods.description: Returns the entire environment map.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Returns the ClassLoader used in this context.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the Locale associated with this context.

methods.name: getMethodType
methods.description: Returns the method type (SERVICE or EVENT).

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value by key.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns all parameters.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HttpServletRequest object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HttpServletResponse object.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves a result value by key.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Returns all results.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the TimeZone object.

methods.name: getTraceLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the current trace log level.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the user login GenericValue.

methods.name: isTraceOn
methods.description: Checks if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: putAllEnv
methods.description: Adds multiple entries to the environment map.

methods.name: putEnv
methods.description: Sets a value in the environment map using a FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: putEnv
methods.description: Sets a value in the environment map with a key, supporting expansion.

methods.name: putParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the parameters map.

methods.name: putResult
methods.description: Adds a result to the results map.

methods.name: removeEnv
methods.description: Removes a value from the environment map using a FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: removeEnv
methods.description: Removes a value from the environment map by key, supporting expansion.

methods.name: setTraceOff
methods.description: Disables tracing.

methods.name: setTraceOn
methods.description: Enables tracing at a specified log level.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Sets the user login and updates environment accordingly.
